title: FactoryManagedOrg
description: An organisation or user account the Software Factory manages: the switch on the Factory organisations page. The account must already be connected, through the Vulnetix GitHub App or a forge connection, and active. Which of its repositories the App can reach is chosen on GitHub when the App is installed; this document does not change that, and status reports it (installationId, repositorySelection, repoCount). metadata.name is the account lower-cased, with every run of characters other than a to z and 0 to 9 replaced by one hyphen: acme-platform for acme-platform, codeberg-org-acme for codeberg.org/acme. Applying also keeps the scope.orgs setting of the factory settings document in step. Deleting the document stops managing the account; the record is kept, so managing it again restores it.

account.description: The account's login as the forge shows it: a GitHub organisation or user (acme-platform), or host/account for an account on another forge (codeberg.org/acme). Matched without regard to case.
